placement_sample.note: Gate(tiger_only_auto=True) on TIGER 2024; Chicago reports locate by house number (84.6%) not street pair (0.5%); house-address placement not measured; GPS on 100% of both samples

end_to_end.corridor: N Western Ave, Chicago, Fullerton Ave to Belmont Ave (1.01 mi)

blockers: no licence on the 2021-2025 layers (2014-2020 CC BY-SA 2.0: share-alike); paid use unclear
street names only in the 2025 layer: 2014-2024 crashes are placed by GPS only, no not-on-the-corridor-street check
2019 layer: ~25% of rows have the columns after TrafficwayDescrip shifted by an unquoted comma (reader reads severity from the unshifted counts)
no crash costs: IDOT publishes per-person NSC costs, not per-crash
user_actions: Ask IDOT Bureau of Data Collection (DOT.DTS.DataRequests@illinois.gov) in writing whether the hub crash layers may be shown in a paid product, and under which licence for 2021-2025
Optional: ask IDOT for street names for 2014-2024 (they exist in the Safety Portal) and its current HSIP benefit-cost crash costs per crash
